# Start here: set your local paths, save, then Knit

Only `INPUT_FILE` needs changing when the workbook is not beside this Rmd.
Use the **same `OUTPUT_ROOT` in every module**. The Rmd itself may be stored anywhere.
No `.Rproj`, helper `.R` file, configuration file or previous analysis is required.
Module 14 only reads other modules' completed outputs for its optional review.

```{r user-settings, include=FALSE}
# A workbook beside this Rmd works with this default. Otherwise enter its full path.
# Windows example: INPUT_FILE <- "C:/my-study/ALL_DATA_clean_for_analysis.xlsx"
INPUT_FILE <- "ALL_DATA_clean_for_analysis.xlsx"

# Automatic results folders are created here; keep this outside the public GitHub folder.
OUTPUT_ROOT <- if (.Platform$OS.type=="windows") "C:/MAMI_results_simple" else "~/MAMI_results_simple"
AUTO_INSTALL_PACKAGES <- TRUE  # Install missing R packages from CRAN; internet required.

# Only module 07 needs BLAST+. Use your installation, or "" to search PATH.
BLASTP <- "C:/Program Files/NCBI/blast-2.17.0+/bin/blastp.exe"
RUN_BLAST <- TRUE  # FALSE is an explicitly annotation-only analysis, not a sequence search.
```

# Scope

This module asks: **among faecal genera associated with arsenic in human milk,
which have human-gut reference representatives with candidate arsenic-related genes?**
Maternal and infant faecal samples are from **one month postpartum** and are
analysed separately. The default matches them to **one-month human milk**.
There are **no PC1, dietary PCA, urine or mediation analyses** in this module.

The network is an **evidence map, not a causal or microbial co-occurrence network**:
`measured milk arsenic — measured faecal genus | human-gut reference genome — candidate gene`.
A taxonomic bridge does not establish that the reference species or gene was
present in a participant. The association with one arsenic species does not
establish that a candidate gene transforms that arsenic species.

## Full-catalogue search, not a 48-genome snapshot

The versioned **UHGG v2.0.2 catalogue** is loaded from its full metadata. The default
annotation and BLAST scopes request **every species representative in that catalogue**
(4,744 in the metadata supplied with the earlier run), with no top-48, top-75 or
per-genus cap. This covers species representatives, **not all 289,232 constituent
genomes/strains and not every human-gut database in existence**. Source genomes,
completed downloads, failed files and missing sequence-query markers are counted
separately. A failed/missing file is never called gene absence.

**This is a large local reference search.** It downloads thousands of annotation and
protein files and can use several gigabytes of disk. Keep the machine online with
adequate storage. Validated downloads, parsed annotation checkpoints and successful
BLAST searches are reused after interruption. The run never stops after finding the
first positive genome. Scope can explicitly be reduced to `"mapped_representatives"`
for all representatives of the selected study genera; that run is labelled narrower.

Taxonomic matching ignores case, extra spaces, underscores, hyphens and harmless
brackets, while retaining meaningful letters and numbers. `Bacteroides_A` is **not**
collapsed to `Bacteroides`; `Christensenellaceae R-7 group` is **not** treated as
`Christensenella`. Documented synonyms can be added in an optional reviewed crosswalk.
Unresolved names receive a suggestion/audit table; suggestions never create network
edges without approval and supporting source information.

The reviewed protein-query panel is the existing 90-sequence UniProt snapshot dated
27 October 2026. It is embedded as short plain-text lines, **not compressed content or
a giant URL vector**. The catalogue expands; this does not pretend that the UniProt
query panel was refreshed. Markers lacking a reviewed query are explicitly unassessed
by homology. BLAST thresholds, the 18-marker panel, cohort tests and FDR are not relaxed.

**Figures:** separate maternal/infant networks and forest plots retain effect sizes,
intervals, n, p and full-family q. Only statistically selected links with a gene
candidate on a mapped human-gut representative are displayed. All other results and
mapping uncertainties remain in the tables. Large networks are **paginated without
omitting eligible species or genes**. Editable SVG is written directly; vector PDF
and 600-dpi PNG use explicit file devices, never RStudio's plot pane.

**Default follow-up is nominal p < 0.05**, clearly exploratory, not FDR significance.
`FOLLOWUP_RULE <- "FDR"` requires q(all milk) < 0.05. External evidence cannot upgrade
a nominal cohort association. Full-catalogue failures label the report **partial**;
check the reference coverage summary before using it as an exhaustive screen.

# Source reading and analysis functions

```{r functions, include=FALSE}
take_rows <- function(x,i) {
  if(is.logical(i)) i <- which(!is.na(i) & i)
  if(!is.numeric(i)) stop("Row selector must be logical or numeric.")
  # Explicit columns: no empty argument in x[i, , drop=FALSE].
  x[i,seq_len(ncol(x)),drop=FALSE]
}
safe_name <- function(x) {
  x <- iconv(x,to="ASCII//TRANSLIT",sub="_")
  x <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]+","_",tolower(x))
  make.unique(gsub("^_+|_+$","",x),sep="_duplicate_")
}
read_sheet <- function(sheet) {
  d <- readxl::read_excel(INPUT_FILE,sheet=sheet,na=c("","NA","N/A","NaN","NULL"),
                         .name_repair="minimal")
  names(d)<-safe_name(names(d));as.data.frame(d,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}
num <- function(x,label) {
  raw<-trimws(as.character(x));raw[toupper(raw)%in%c("","NA","N/A","NAN","NULL")]<-NA_character_
  value<-suppressWarnings(as.numeric(raw))
  if(any(!is.na(raw)&is.na(value))) stop("Nonnumeric values in ",label,"; not zero-imputed.")
  value
}
std_family <- function(family_code, sample_id = NULL) {
  z <- toupper(trimws(as.character(family_code)))
  z[z %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NULL", "NAN")] <- NA_character_
  z <- sub("\\.0$", "", z)
  is_w <- !is.na(z) & grepl("^W0*[0-9]+$", z)
  z[is_w] <- paste0("W", as.integer(sub("^W", "", z[is_w])))
  is_num <- !is.na(z) & grepl("^0*[0-9]+$", z)
  z[is_num] <- as.character(as.integer(z[is_num]))
  is_suffix <- !is.na(z) & grepl("^0*[0-9]+[A-Z]+$", z)
  z[is_suffix] <- paste0(as.integer(sub("^0*([0-9]+)[A-Z]+$", "\\1", z[is_suffix])),
                         sub("^0*[0-9]+", "", z[is_suffix]))
  if (!is.null(sample_id)) {
    s <- toupper(trimws(as.character(sample_id)))
    # The DB group identifier is NOT a unique mother/infant identifier.
    db <- !is.na(s) & grepl("^SDB[0-9]+[A-Z]+[0-9]{2}H$", s)
    z[db] <- sub("^S(DB[0-9]+[A-Z]+)[0-9]{2}H$", "\\1", s[db])
    m <- !is.na(s) & grepl("^S[0-9]{3}M[0-9]", s)
    z[m] <- as.character(as.integer(sub("^S0*([0-9]+)M.*", "\\1", s[m])))
    # W sample ID is only a fallback when explicit W code is missing.
    w <- !is.na(s) & grepl("^S[0-9]{3}WM", s) & is.na(z)
    if (any(w)) z[w] <- paste0("W", as.integer(sub("^S0*([0-9]+)WM.*", "\\1", s[w])))
  }
  z
}

write_csv <- function(d,name) {
  if(!ncol(d))d<-data.frame(status=character())
  write.csv(d,file.path(TABLE_DIR,paste0(name,".csv")),row.names=FALSE,na="")
}
bind_rows_safe <- function(x,template=data.frame()) {
  x<-Filter(function(z)is.data.frame(z)&&nrow(z)>0,x)
  if(length(x)) do.call(rbind,x) else take_rows(template,integer(0))
}
bh <- function(p) {
  out<-rep(NA_real_,length(p));ok<-is.finite(p)
  if(any(ok))out[ok]<-p.adjust(p[ok],"BH",n=length(p))
  out
}
seed_key <- function(x) as.integer((sum(utf8ToInt(paste(x,collapse="|")))+20261027) %% 2147483647)
cor_stats <- function(x,y,bootstrap=FALSE,seed=1L) {
  ans<-data.frame(rho=NA_real_,ci_low=NA_real_,ci_high=NA_real_,p=NA_real_,
                  bootstrap_valid=0L,status="not estimated")
  if(length(x)<MIN_N){ans$status<-"too few samples";return(ans)}
  if(length(unique(x))<2L||length(unique(y))<2L){ans$status<-"constant variable";return(ans)}
  ct<-suppressWarnings(cor.test(x,y,method="spearman",exact=FALSE))
  ans$rho<-unname(ct$estimate);ans$p<-ct$p.value;ans$status<-"estimated"
  if(bootstrap) {
    set.seed(seed)
    bs<-replicate(BOOTSTRAP_N,{
      j<-sample.int(length(x),length(x),replace=TRUE)
      if(length(unique(x[j]))<2L||length(unique(y[j]))<2L) NA_real_ else
        suppressWarnings(cor(x[j],y[j],method="spearman"))
    })
    bs<-bs[is.finite(bs)];ans$bootstrap_valid<-length(bs)
    if(length(bs)>=max(100L,ceiling(0.8*BOOTSTRAP_N))) {
      ci<-quantile(bs,c(.025,.975),names=FALSE);ans$ci_low<-ci[1];ans$ci_high<-ci[2]
    }
  }
  ans
}
load_micro <- function(sheet,group) {
  d<-read_sheet(sheet);d$family_id<-std_family(d$family_code,d$sample_id)
  taxa<-grep("^g_",names(d),value=TRUE)
  if(length(taxa)<2L)stop("No genus-count columns in ",sheet)
  counts<-as.matrix(data.frame(lapply(taxa,function(v)num(d[[v]],paste(sheet,v))),check.names=FALSE))
  colnames(counts)<-taxa
  if(any(counts<0,na.rm=TRUE)||any(abs(counts-round(counts))>1e-7,na.rm=TRUE))
    stop("Expected nonnegative raw integer counts: ",sheet)
  depth<-rowSums(counts);bad<-rowSums(!is.finite(counts))
  keep<-bad==0L&is.finite(depth)&depth>0&!is.na(d$family_id)
  qc<-data.frame(group=group,sample_id=d$sample_id,family_id=d$family_id,
                 depth=depth,missing_counts=bad,included=keep)
  if(anyDuplicated(d$family_id[keep]))stop("Duplicate eligible microbiota family IDs: ",sheet)
  counts<-take_rows(counts,keep);meta<-d[keep,c("family_id","sample_id"),drop=FALSE]
  ra<-sweep(counts,1,rowSums(counts),"/");rownames(ra)<-meta$family_id
  list(meta=meta,counts=counts,ra=ra,qc=qc)
}
zero_clr <- function(ra,delta) {
  stopifnot(ncol(ra)>=2L,all(is.finite(ra)),all(ra>=0),all(rowSums(ra)>0))
  d<-ra;d[d==0]<-delta;d<-sweep(d,1,rowSums(d),"/")
  log(d)-rowMeans(log(d))
}
run_group <- function(micro,milk,group) {
  effects<-list();audits<-list();eligibility<-list();statuses<-list()
  outcomes<-c("asb","ias","dma","mma","methylated_as","non_asb_as")
  for(o in outcomes) {
    take<-is.finite(milk[[o]])&milk$family_id%in%micro$meta$family_id
    md<-take_rows(milk,take);idx<-match(md$family_id,micro$meta$family_id)
    if(anyDuplicated(md$family_id))stop("Do not pool repeated milk measurements per family.")
    ra<-take_rows(micro$ra,idx);n<-nrow(ra)
    positive<-if(n)colSums(ra>0) else rep(0L,ncol(ra))
    above<-if(n)colSums(ra>=MIN_RA) else rep(0L,ncol(ra))
    ambiguous<-grepl("uncultured|unclassified|unknown",colnames(ra),ignore.case=TRUE)
    keep<-n>0&above>=ceiling(MIN_PREVALENCE*n)&positive>0&!ambiguous
    variable<-if(n>1L)apply(ra,2,function(x)length(unique(x))>1L) else rep(FALSE,ncol(ra))
    audit<-data.frame(group=group,milk_month=MILK_MONTH,arsenic=o,feature=colnames(ra),
      n=n,n_positive=positive,n_at_threshold=above,selected=keep,raw_RA_varies=variable,
      reason=ifelse(ambiguous,"ambiguous label",ifelse(positive==0,"all zero in eligible set",
        ifelse(!keep,"below abundance/prevalence rule",ifelse(!variable,"constant raw RA","eligible")))))
    audits[[o]]<-audit
    eligibility[[o]]<-data.frame(group=rep(group,n),arsenic=rep(o,n),family_id=md$family_id,
                                milk_sample=md$sample_id,stool_sample=micro$meta$sample_id[idx])
    selected<-ra[seq_len(nrow(ra)),keep,drop=FALSE]
    status<-if(n<MIN_N)"insufficient eligible samples" else if(ncol(selected)<2L)
      "fewer than two retained genera" else if(any(rowSums(selected)<=0))
        "zero retained mass" else "estimated"
    statuses[[o]]<-data.frame(group=group,arsenic=o,n=n,n_genera=ncol(selected),status=status)
    if(status!="estimated")next
    for(delta in c(ZERO_REPLACEMENTS,NA_real_)) {
      method<-if(is.na(delta))"raw_RA_sensitivity" else paste0("CLR_",format(delta,scientific=TRUE))
      mat<-if(is.na(delta))selected else zero_clr(selected,delta)
      primary<-is.finite(delta)&&delta==PRIMARY_ZERO
      for(tax in colnames(selected)) {
        j<-match(tax,colnames(ra))
        stat<-if(variable[j])cor_stats(md[[o]],mat[seq_len(nrow(mat)),tax],bootstrap=primary,
                                      seed=seed_key(c(group,o,tax))) else
          data.frame(rho=NA_real_,ci_low=NA_real_,ci_high=NA_real_,p=NA_real_,
                     bootstrap_valid=0L,status="constant raw RA; not tested")
        effects[[length(effects)+1L]]<-cbind(data.frame(group=group,milk_month=MILK_MONTH,
          arsenic=o,feature=tax,n=n,n_positive=positive[j],n_at_threshold=above[j],
          n_CLR_genera=ncol(selected),method=method,pseudocount=delta,is_primary=primary),stat)
      }
    }
  }
  list(effects=bind_rows_safe(effects),filtering=bind_rows_safe(audits),
       eligibility=bind_rows_safe(eligibility),status=bind_rows_safe(statuses))
}
normal_genus <- function(x)gsub("[^a-z0-9]","",tolower(sub("^g_","",x)))
pretty_genus <- function(x) {
  x<-gsub("_"," ",sub("^g_","",x));paste0(toupper(substr(x,1,1)),substring(x,2))
}
pretty_as <- function(x)unname(c(asb="AsB",ias="iAs",dma="DMA",mma="MMA",
                               methylated_as="MMA + DMA",non_asb_as="Non-AsB As")[x])
```

# File-only graphics engine and preflight

Figures are drawn to explicit files, never to RStudio's plot pane. The editable
SVG is written directly as XML first; vector PDF and 600-dpi PNG are attempted
independently. An unavailable PNG backend is logged and cannot destroy the
scientific tables or vector exports. No failure is silently labelled complete.

```{r file-only-graphics, include=FALSE}
# Explicit file-only renderer. Never uses RStudioGD, ggsave's default device,
# print.ggplot(), or knitr's PNG capture. Coordinates are points (72 per inch).
FIGURE_REGISTRY <- list()
DEVICE_ATTEMPTS <- list()
M07_GRAPHICS_RELEASE <- "M07_network_file_devices_v2"
COL <- list(ink="#243744", muted="#5D6A72", rule="#CCD4DA", paper="#FFFFFF",
  study="#F0F5F8", reference="#F7F5EF", positive="#AE5638", negative="#2C6687",
  ref="#81898F", faint="#EDF0F2")
xml_escape <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed=TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed=TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed=TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', "&quot;", x, fixed=TRUE)
  x
}
plain_text <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\u2013|\u2014|\u2212", "-", as.character(x))
  x <- gsub("\u2265", ">=", x, fixed=TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\u03c1", "rho", x, fixed=TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\u2192", "--", x, fixed=TRUE)
  iconv(x, from="", to="ASCII//TRANSLIT", sub="?")
}
scene_new <- function(width_pt, height_pt, title) {
  s <- new.env(parent=emptyenv())
  s$width <- as.numeric(width_pt); s$height <- as.numeric(height_pt)
  s$title <- plain_text(title); s$items <- list()
  s
}
scene_add <- function(s, type, ...) {
  s$items[[length(s$items)+1L]] <- c(list(type=type), list(...))
  invisible(s)
}
sc_rect <- function(s,x,y,w,h,fill=COL$paper,stroke=COL$rule,lw=.6,r=0) {
  scene_add(s,"rect",x=x,y=y,w=w,h=h,fill=fill,stroke=stroke,lw=lw,r=r)
}
sc_text <- function(s,x,y,text,size=10,colour=COL$ink,face="plain",anchor="start") {
  scene_add(s,"text",x=x,y=y,text=plain_text(text),size=size,colour=colour,face=face,anchor=anchor)
}
sc_multiline <- function(s,x,y,text,size=10,leading=13,colour=COL$ink,
                         face="plain",anchor="start") {
  lines <- strsplit(as.character(text),"\n",fixed=TRUE)[[1L]]
  if (!length(lines)) lines <- ""
  yy <- y+(seq_along(lines)-(length(lines)+1)/2)*leading
  for (i in seq_along(lines)) sc_text(s,x,yy[i],lines[i],size,colour,face,anchor)
  invisible(s)
}
sc_line <- function(s,x,y,xend,yend,colour=COL$rule,lw=.7,dash="") {
  scene_add(s,"line",x=x,y=y,xend=xend,yend=yend,colour=colour,lw=lw,dash=dash)
}
sc_circle <- function(s,x,y,r=3,fill=COL$paper,stroke=COL$ink,lw=1) {
  scene_add(s,"circle",x=x,y=y,r=r,fill=fill,stroke=stroke,lw=lw)
}
sc_curve <- function(s,x,y,xend,yend,colour=COL$ref,lw=1,dash="") {
  t <- seq(0,1,length.out=65L); dx <- xend-x
  xx <- (1-t)^3*x+3*(1-t)^2*t*(x+.42*dx)+3*(1-t)*t^2*(x+.58*dx)+t^3*xend
  yy <- (1-t)^3*y+3*(1-t)^2*t*y+3*(1-t)*t^2*yend+t^3*yend
  scene_add(s,"polyline",xx=xx,yy=yy,colour=colour,lw=lw,dash=dash)
}
write_scene_svg <- function(s,path) {
  # This export is plain XML; it needs NO R graphics device or display server.
  f <- function(x) formatC(x,digits=3,format="f",decimal.mark=".")
  z <- c('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>',
    sprintf('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="%sin" height="%sin" viewBox="0 0 %s %s" role="img">',
      f(s$width/72),f(s$height/72),f(s$width),f(s$height)),
    paste0("<title>",xml_escape(s$title),"</title>"),
    sprintf('<rect width="%s" height="%s" fill="white"/>',f(s$width),f(s$height)))
  for (a in s$items) {
    if (a$type=="rect") z <- c(z,sprintf(
      '<rect x="%s" y="%s" width="%s" height="%s" rx="%s" fill="%s" stroke="%s" stroke-width="%s"/>',
      f(a$x),f(a$y),f(a$w),f(a$h),f(a$r),a$fill,a$stroke,f(a$lw)))
    if (a$type=="text") {
      weight <- if (a$face %in% c("bold","bold.italic")) "bold" else "normal"
      style <- if (a$face %in% c("italic","bold.italic")) "italic" else "normal"
      z <- c(z,sprintf(paste0('<text x="%s" y="%s" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" ',
        'font-size="%s" font-weight="%s" font-style="%s" text-anchor="%s" ',
        'dominant-baseline="central" fill="%s">%s</text>'),
        f(a$x),f(a$y),f(a$size),weight,style,a$anchor,a$colour,xml_escape(a$text)))
    }
    if (a$type=="line") z <- c(z,sprintf(
      '<line x1="%s" y1="%s" x2="%s" y2="%s" stroke="%s" stroke-width="%s" stroke-dasharray="%s" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
      f(a$x),f(a$y),f(a$xend),f(a$yend),a$colour,f(a$lw),a$dash))
    if (a$type=="circle") z <- c(z,sprintf(
      '<circle cx="%s" cy="%s" r="%s" fill="%s" stroke="%s" stroke-width="%s"/>',
      f(a$x),f(a$y),f(a$r),a$fill,a$stroke,f(a$lw)))
    if (a$type=="polyline") {
      pts <- paste(paste(f(a$xx),f(a$yy),sep=","),collapse=" ")
      z <- c(z,sprintf(
        '<polyline points="%s" fill="none" stroke="%s" stroke-width="%s" stroke-dasharray="%s" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>',
        pts,a$colour,f(a$lw),a$dash))
    }
  }
  writeLines(c(z,"</svg>"),path,useBytes=TRUE)
  invisible(path)
}
draw_scene_grid <- function(s) {
  # Called ONLY after this module has explicitly opened a file device.
  if (grDevices::dev.cur()==1L) stop("No explicit output device is open.")
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.rect(gp=grid::gpar(fill="white",col=NA))
  xx <- function(x) grid::unit(x/s$width,"npc")
  yy <- function(y) grid::unit(1-y/s$height,"npc")
  lty <- function(x) if (!nzchar(x)) "solid" else if (x=="1,3") "dotted" else "dashed"
  # R line widths are in nominal 1/96 inch; scene widths are 1/72 inch.
  for (a in s$items) {
    if (a$type=="rect") {
      gp <- grid::gpar(fill=a$fill,col=a$stroke,lwd=a$lw*96/72)
      if (a$r>0) {
        grid::grid.roundrect(x=xx(a$x+a$w/2),y=yy(a$y+a$h/2),
          width=xx(a$w),height=grid::unit(a$h/s$height,"npc"),
          r=grid::unit(a$r,"bigpts"),gp=gp)
      } else grid::grid.rect(x=xx(a$x+a$w/2),y=yy(a$y+a$h/2),
        width=xx(a$w),height=grid::unit(a$h/s$height,"npc"),gp=gp)
    }
    if (a$type=="text") grid::grid.text(a$text,x=xx(a$x),y=yy(a$y),
      just=c(if(a$anchor=="start")"left" else if(a$anchor=="end")"right" else "centre","centre"),
      gp=grid::gpar(fontfamily="sans",fontsize=a$size,fontface=a$face,col=a$colour))
    if (a$type=="line") grid::grid.lines(x=xx(c(a$x,a$xend)),y=yy(c(a$y,a$yend)),
      gp=grid::gpar(col=a$colour,lwd=a$lw*96/72,lty=lty(a$dash),lineend="round"))
    if (a$type=="polyline") grid::grid.lines(x=xx(a$xx),y=yy(a$yy),
      gp=grid::gpar(col=a$colour,lwd=a$lw*96/72,lty=lty(a$dash),lineend="round"))
    if (a$type=="circle") grid::grid.circle(x=xx(a$x),y=yy(a$y),r=grid::unit(a$r,"bigpts"),
      gp=grid::gpar(fill=a$fill,col=a$stroke,lwd=a$lw*96/72))
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
write_device_attempts <- function() {
  d <- bind_rows_safe(DEVICE_ATTEMPTS)
  write.csv(d,file.path(ROOT,"logs","GRAPHICS_DEVICE_ATTEMPTS.csv"),row.names=FALSE,na="")
  invisible(d)
}
file_device_attempt <- function(s,path,device,dpi=NA_integer_,preflight=FALSE) {
  before <- grDevices::dev.list(); old_ids <- if(is.null(before))integer() else as.integer(before)
  warnings_seen <- character(); success <- FALSE; detail <- ""
  # Only close devices opened here, never the user's existing devices.
  close_new <- function() {
    current <- grDevices::dev.list()
    if (!is.null(current)) for (id in setdiff(as.integer(current),old_ids)) {
      try(grDevices::dev.off(which=id),silent=TRUE)
    }
  }
  on.exit(close_new(),add=TRUE)
  if(file.exists(path)) unlink(path)
  detail <- tryCatch(withCallingHandlers({
    if(device=="base_pdf") grDevices::pdf(path,width=s$width/72,height=s$height/72,
      onefile=FALSE,family="Helvetica",useDingbats=FALSE,paper="special",bg="white")
    if(device=="ragg_png") ragg::agg_png(path,width=s$width/72,height=s$height/72,
      units="in",res=dpi,background="white")
    if(device=="cairo_png") grDevices::png(path,width=s$width/72,height=s$height/72,
      units="in",res=dpi,type="cairo-png",bg="white")
    draw_scene_grid(s)
    close_new()
    if(!file.exists(path)||file.info(path)$size<100L) stop("No nonempty figure file was written.")
    success <- TRUE
    "File exported and device closed"
  },warning=function(w) {warnings_seen <<- c(warnings_seen,conditionMessage(w));invokeRestart("muffleWarning")}),
    error=function(e) conditionMessage(e))
  close_new()
  if(!success && file.exists(path)) unlink(path)
  DEVICE_ATTEMPTS[[length(DEVICE_ATTEMPTS)+1L]] <<- data.frame(
    timestamp=as.character(Sys.time()),file=path,device=device,dpi=dpi,
    width_in=s$width/72,height_in=s$height/72,success=success,preflight=preflight,
    detail=detail,warnings=paste(unique(warnings_seen),collapse=" | "),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  write_device_attempts()
  success
}
save_scene <- function(s,stem,preflight=FALSE) {
  stopifnot(is.environment(s),is.finite(s$width),is.finite(s$height),
            s$width>0,s$height>0,s$width<=1200,s$height<=900)
  directory <- if(preflight) file.path(ROOT,"logs","graphics_test") else FIG_DIR
  dir.create(directory,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
  stem <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]","_",stem)
  svg <- file.path(directory,paste0(stem,".svg"))
  pdf <- file.path(directory,paste0(stem,".pdf"))
  png <- file.path(directory,paste0(stem,".png"))
  for (p in c(svg,pdf,png)) if(file.exists(p)) unlink(p)
  # Write vector XML first. A failed PNG device cannot remove the SVG or PDF.
  write_scene_svg(s,svg)
  pdf_ok <- file_device_attempt(s,pdf,"base_pdf",preflight=preflight)
  dpi <- if(preflight)96L else PLOT_DPI
  png_ok <- FALSE
  pixels <- (s$width/72*dpi)*(s$height/72*dpi)
  if(pixels<=MAX_PNG_PIXELS) {
    if(requireNamespace("ragg",quietly=TRUE))
      png_ok <- file_device_attempt(s,png,"ragg_png",dpi,preflight)
    if(!png_ok && isTRUE(capabilities("cairo")))
      png_ok <- file_device_attempt(s,png,"cairo_png",dpi,preflight)
  }
  if(!png_ok && (pixels>MAX_PNG_PIXELS ||
       (!requireNamespace("ragg",quietly=TRUE) && !isTRUE(capabilities("cairo"))))) {
    DEVICE_ATTEMPTS[[length(DEVICE_ATTEMPTS)+1L]] <<- data.frame(
      timestamp=as.character(Sys.time()),file=png,device="PNG_not_attempted",dpi=dpi,
      width_in=s$width/72,height_in=s$height/72,success=FALSE,preflight=preflight,
      detail=if(pixels>MAX_PNG_PIXELS)"Raster pixel limit exceeded; vector retained, no silent DPI reduction" else
        "Neither ragg nor Cairo PNG support is available; vector exports retained",
      warnings="",stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
    write_device_attempts()
  }
  status <- if(pdf_ok && png_ok) "complete" else "vectors_available_graphics_warning"
  if(!preflight) {
    FIGURE_REGISTRY[[length(FIGURE_REGISTRY)+1L]] <<- data.frame(
      figure=stem,title=s$title,svg=svg,pdf=if(pdf_ok)pdf else NA_character_,
      png=if(png_ok)png else NA_character_,png_dpi=if(png_ok)dpi else NA_integer_,
      width_in=s$width/72,height_in=s$height/72,status=status,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
    write.csv(bind_rows_safe(FIGURE_REGISTRY),file.path(ROOT,"FIGURE_EXPORT_MANIFEST.csv"),row.names=FALSE,na="")
  }
  if(!pdf_ok || !png_ok) message("Figure ",stem,": editable SVG retained. ",
    if(!pdf_ok)"PDF failed; " else "PDF saved; ",
    if(!png_ok)"PNG unavailable. See logs/GRAPHICS_DEVICE_ATTEMPTS.csv." else "PNG saved.")
  # Never print a plot: printing would open RStudio/knitr's default PNG device.
  invisible(list(svg=svg,pdf_ok=pdf_ok,png_ok=png_ok))
}
fmt_p <- function(x) {
  ans <- rep("NA",length(x)); ok <- is.finite(x)
  ans[ok] <- ifelse(x[ok]<.001,formatC(x[ok],format="e",digits=1),sprintf("%.3f",x[ok]))
  ans
}
wrap_label <- function(x,width=24L) paste(strwrap(plain_text(x),width=width),collapse="\n")
row_pages <- function(a,max_rows) {
  if(!nrow(a)) return(list(a))
  ii <- split(seq_len(nrow(a)),ceiling(seq_len(nrow(a))/max_rows))
  lapply(ii,function(i) take_rows(a,i))
}

# Pure display-selection helper. Never refits a model or recalculates p/q.
# Externally supported means a gene-specific candidate on a protein of the SAME
# UHGG representative, not mere genus presence in a gut catalogue.
reference_plot_selection <- function(primary, associations, mapping, candidates,
                                     reference_genomes, markers, rule="nominal") {
  stopifnot(rule %in% c("nominal","FDR"))
  required <- list(
    primary=c("group","feature","arsenic","p","q_all_milk"),
    associations=c("group","feature","arsenic","association_id","p","q_all_milk"),
    mapping=c("feature","species_rep"),
    candidates=c("feature","species_rep","protein_id","gene","preferred_name",
                 "reference_evidence","sequence_supported"),
    reference_genomes=c("species_rep"), markers=c("gene"))
  inputs <- list(primary=primary,associations=associations,mapping=mapping,
    candidates=candidates,reference_genomes=reference_genomes,markers=markers)
  for(nm in names(required)) {
    missing <- setdiff(required[[nm]],names(inputs[[nm]]))
    if(length(missing)) stop("Display filter: ",nm," lacks ",paste(missing,collapse=", "))
  }
  nonblank <- function(x) !is.na(x) & nzchar(trimws(as.character(x)))
  key <- function(feature,representative) {
    if(!length(feature)) return(character())
    paste(feature,representative,sep="|")
  }
  ca <- candidates
  n <- nrow(ca)
  ca$known_gut_representative <- nonblank(ca$species_rep) &
    ca$species_rep %in% reference_genomes$species_rep
  ca$known_taxonomic_bridge <- key(ca$feature,ca$species_rep) %in%
    key(mapping$feature,mapping$species_rep)
  ca$protein_from_same_representative <- rep(FALSE,n)
  valid_ids <- nonblank(ca$species_rep) & nonblank(ca$protein_id)
  if(any(valid_ids)) ca$protein_from_same_representative[valid_ids] <-
    startsWith(ca$protein_id[valid_ids],paste0(ca$species_rep[valid_ids],"_"))
  exact_annotation <- annotation_matches(ca$preferred_name,ca$gene)
  exact_annotation[is.na(exact_annotation)] <- FALSE
  homology <- !is.na(ca$sequence_supported) & ca$sequence_supported
  supported_label <- ca$reference_evidence %in%
    c("Annotation-only candidate","Homology + annotation candidate","Homology-only candidate")
  evidence_consistent <-
    (ca$reference_evidence=="Annotation-only candidate" & exact_annotation) |
    (ca$reference_evidence=="Homology + annotation candidate" & exact_annotation & homology) |
    (ca$reference_evidence=="Homology-only candidate" & homology)
  evidence_consistent[is.na(evidence_consistent)] <- FALSE
  ca$display_candidate_eligible <- ca$known_gut_representative &
    ca$known_taxonomic_bridge & ca$protein_from_same_representative &
    ca$gene %in% markers$gene & supported_label & evidence_consistent
  ca$display_evidence_status <- ifelse(ca$display_candidate_eligible,
    "Eligible external candidate; NOT a participant gene measurement",
    "Ineligible reference row: inspect representative, protein, marker and evidence fields")
  valid_candidates <- take_rows(ca,ca$display_candidate_eligible)
  audit <- primary
  audit$reference_search_status <- rep(REFERENCE_STATUS,nrow(audit))
  audit$passes_statistical_rule <- if(rule=="nominal")
    is.finite(audit$p)&audit$p<0.05 else
    is.finite(audit$q_all_milk)&audit$q_all_milk<0.05
  audit$reference_followup_performed <- audit$feature %in% unique(mapping$feature)
  audit$has_gut_gene_reference <- rep(NA,nrow(audit))
  audit$n_gene_supported_representatives <- rep(NA_integer_,nrow(audit))
  audit$n_candidate_markers <- rep(NA_integer_,nrow(audit))
  audit$reference_status <- rep("Not assessed: not selected for taxonomic follow-up",nrow(audit))
  for(g in unique(audit$feature[audit$reference_followup_performed])) {
    ix <- which(audit$feature==g)
    cg <- take_rows(valid_candidates,valid_candidates$feature==g)
    mg <- take_rows(mapping,mapping$feature==g & nonblank(mapping$species_rep))
    audit$has_gut_gene_reference[ix] <- nrow(cg)>0L
    audit$n_gene_supported_representatives[ix] <- length(unique(cg$species_rep))
    audit$n_candidate_markers[ix] <- length(unique(cg$gene))
    audit$reference_status[ix] <- if(nrow(cg))
      "Gene candidate on a mapped human-gut representative" else if(nrow(mg))
      "Mapped gut representatives, but no qualifying gene candidate in this screen" else
      "No documented genus-to-reference link in the full catalogue"
  }
  audit$included_in_main_plot <- audit$passes_statistical_rule &
    !is.na(audit$has_gut_gene_reference) & audit$has_gut_gene_reference
  audit$display_reason <- ifelse(audit$included_in_main_plot,
    "Plotted: statistical rule AND gut reference gene candidate",
    ifelse(!audit$passes_statistical_rule,"Not plotted: statistical rule not met",
      "Not plotted: no qualifying mapped gene evidence; inspect coverage and taxonomy audits"))
  supported_features <- unique(valid_candidates$feature)
  shown <- take_rows(associations,associations$feature %in% supported_features)
  # Recheck the chosen statistical rule, never rely only on upstream selection.
  shown <- take_rows(shown,if(rule=="nominal")is.finite(shown$p)&shown$p<0.05 else
    is.finite(shown$q_all_milk)&shown$q_all_milk<0.05)
  shown$has_gut_gene_reference <- rep(TRUE,nrow(shown))
  if(nrow(shown)) {
    mi <- match(shown$feature,audit$feature)
    shown$n_gene_supported_representatives <- audit$n_gene_supported_representatives[mi]
    shown$n_candidate_markers <- audit$n_candidate_markers[mi]
  } else {
    shown$n_gene_supported_representatives <- integer()
    shown$n_candidate_markers <- integer()
  }
  pc <- take_rows(valid_candidates,valid_candidates$feature %in% shown$feature)
  pm <- take_rows(mapping,key(mapping$feature,mapping$species_rep) %in%
    key(pc$feature,pc$species_rep))
  # Strict table uses the original milk-wide FDR, not an FDR of displayed links.
  strict <- take_rows(shown,is.finite(shown$q_all_milk)&shown$q_all_milk<0.05)
  groups <- unique(c("Maternal","Infant",as.character(primary$group)))
  counts <- bind_rows_safe(lapply(groups,function(gr) {
    d <- take_rows(audit,audit$group==gr)
    s <- take_rows(shown,shown$group==gr)
    data.frame(group=gr,display_rule=rule,n_primary_tests=nrow(d),
      n_finite_p=sum(is.finite(d$p)),n_statistical_followup=sum(d$passes_statistical_rule),
      n_plotted_links=nrow(s),n_plotted_genera=length(unique(s$feature)),
      n_omitted_for_reference=sum(d$passes_statistical_rule & !d$included_in_main_plot),
      n_plotted_milk_wide_FDR=sum(is.finite(s$q_all_milk)&s$q_all_milk<0.05),
      status=if(nrow(s))"Supported network/forest exported" else
        "No main figure: no link meets BOTH display criteria",
      stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  }))
  list(associations=shown,candidates=pc,mapping=pm,audit=audit,counts=counts,
       strict_FDR=strict,candidate_checks=ca)
}

network_pages <- function(a) {
  pages <- list()
  if(!nrow(a))return(pages)
  for(g in sort(unique(a$feature))) {
    aa <- take_rows(a,a$feature==g)
    ids <- sort(unique(plot_mapping$species_rep[plot_mapping$feature==g]))
    blocks <- split(ids,ceiling(seq_along(ids)/8L))
    for(ids1 in blocks) {
      cc <- take_rows(plot_candidates,plot_candidates$feature==g & plot_candidates$species_rep%in%ids1)
      genes <- sort(unique(cc$gene))
      gene_blocks <- split(genes,ceiling(seq_along(genes)/8L))
      for(gs in gene_blocks) {
        cp <- take_rows(cc,cc$gene%in%gs)
        mp <- take_rows(plot_mapping,plot_mapping$feature==g & plot_mapping$species_rep%in%cp$species_rep)
        pages[[length(pages)+1L]] <- list(a=aa,mapping=mp,candidates=cp)
      }
    }
  }
  pages
}
network_geometry <- function(a,s,page_map,page_candidates) {
  # Main network contains only representatives with an eligible candidate protein.
  # Full mapping/annotation negatives and unresolved labels remain in audit tables.
  gen <- sort(unique(a$feature)); refrows <- list()
  for(g in gen) {
    rr <- take_rows(page_map,page_map$feature==g)
    if(!nrow(rr)) stop("Display gate mismatch: no supported representative for ",g)
    if(nrow(rr)) {
      rr <- rr[order(rr$gtdb_species,rr$species_rep),seq_len(ncol(rr)),drop=FALSE]
      for(i in seq_len(nrow(rr))) {
        cg <- take_rows(page_candidates,page_candidates$feature==g & page_candidates$species_rep==rr$species_rep[i])
        if(!nrow(cg)) stop("Display gate mismatch: reference has no candidate protein")
        refrows[[length(refrows)+1L]] <- data.frame(id=paste("R",g,rr$species_rep[i],sep=":"),
          feature=g,species_rep=rr$species_rep[i],species=if(nzchar(rr$gtdb_species[i]))rr$gtdb_species[i] else paste(rr$gtdb_genus[i],"unclassified species"),
          real=TRUE,has_marker=nrow(cg)>0L,
          evidence_label=if(!nrow(cg))"No specific marker annotation in this reference screen" else
            if(any(cg$reference_evidence=="Homology + annotation candidate"))"Candidate: annotation + homology" else
            if(any(cg$sequence_supported))"Candidate: sequence homology" else "Candidate: annotation only",
          stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
      }
    } else refrows[[length(refrows)+1L]] <- data.frame(id=paste0("U:",g),feature=g,
      species_rep="",species="Taxonomic link unresolved",real=FALSE,has_marker=FALSE,
      evidence_label="Taxonomic link unresolved",stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  }
  refs <- bind_rows_safe(refrows)
  top <- 176; bottom <- s$height-148
  rr_y <- if(nrow(refs)==1L) (top+bottom)/2 else seq(top,bottom,length.out=nrow(refs))
  refs$y <- rr_y
  ng <- lapply(gen,function(g) {
    yi <- refs$y[refs$feature==g]
    data.frame(id=paste0("G:",g),type="Observed genus",feature=g,
      label=pretty_genus(g),x=315,y=mean(yi),width=202,height=58)
  })
  genera <- bind_rows_safe(ng)
  ars <- intersect(c("asb","ias","dma","mma","methylated_as","non_asb_as"),unique(a$arsenic))
  ya <- if(length(ars)==1L) mean(genera$y) else seq(top,bottom,length.out=length(ars))
  arnodes <- data.frame(id=paste0("A:",ars),type="Milk arsenic",feature=ars,label=pretty_as(ars),
    x=80,y=ya,width=116,height=42)
  refnodes <- data.frame(id=refs$id,type=ifelse(refs$real,"Human-gut representative","Unresolved reference"),
    feature=refs$species_rep,label=refs$species,x=652,y=refs$y,width=262,height=58)
  cc <- take_rows(page_candidates,page_candidates$feature %in% gen)
  genes <- sort(unique(cc$gene))
  yh <- if(length(genes)==1L) mean(refs$y[refs$has_marker]) else
    if(length(genes))seq(top,bottom,length.out=length(genes)) else numeric()
  gn <- data.frame(id=if(length(genes))paste0("H:",genes)else character(),
    type=rep("Candidate gene",length(genes)),
    feature=genes,label=genes,x=rep(932,length(genes)),y=yh,
    width=rep(102,length(genes)),height=rep(50,length(genes)))
  nodes <- rbind(arnodes,genera,refnodes,gn)
  edges <- list()
  add_edge <- function(from,to,kind,assoc="",rho=NA_real_) {
    edges[[length(edges)+1L]] <<- data.frame(from=from,to=to,kind=kind,
      association_id=assoc,rho=rho,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  }
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(a))) add_edge(paste0("A:",a$arsenic[i]),paste0("G:",a$feature[i]),
    a$evidence[i],a$association_id[i],a$rho[i])
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(refs))) add_edge(paste0("G:",refs$feature[i]),refs$id[i],
    if(refs$real[i])"Taxonomic reference link" else "Unresolved reference")
  if(nrow(cc)) {
    cols <- c("feature","species_rep","gene","reference_evidence")
    u <- unique(cc[seq_len(nrow(cc)),cols,drop=FALSE])
    # Show the strongest available evidence per representative/marker pair;
    # every contributing protein remains in the candidate-links table.
    priority <- c("Homology + annotation candidate"=1L,
                  "Homology-only candidate"=2L,"Annotation-only candidate"=3L)
    u <- take_rows(u,order(unname(priority[u$reference_evidence]),na.last=TRUE))
    u <- take_rows(u,!duplicated(paste(u$feature,u$species_rep,u$gene,sep="|")))
    for(i in seq_len(nrow(u))) add_edge(paste("R",u$feature[i],u$species_rep[i],sep=":"),
      paste0("H:",u$gene[i]),u$reference_evidence[i])
  }
  list(nodes=nodes,edges=bind_rows_safe(edges),refs=refs)
}
network_scene <- function(a,gr,page,total,page_map,page_candidates) {
  W <- 1008
  nref <- sum(vapply(unique(a$feature),function(g)
    max(1L,length(unique(page_map$species_rep[page_map$feature==g]))),integer(1)))
  H <- min(900,max(540,310+max(nref,length(unique(a$arsenic)),1)*62))
  s <- scene_new(W,H,paste(gr,"milk arsenic / stool genus / human-gut gene candidates"))
  sc_text(s,24,27,paste(gr,"faecal genera and milk arsenic"),19,face="bold")
  sc_text(s,24,51,paste0("Month-1 stool | Milk month ",MILK_MONTH,
    " | ",if(FOLLOWUP_RULE=="nominal")"Nominal p < 0.05" else "q(all milk) < 0.05",
    " + human-gut gene-reference support | Page ",page,"/",total),10.5,colour=COL$muted)
  sc_rect(s,16,78,417,H-191,COL$study,COL$study,r=7)
  sc_rect(s,497,78,495,H-191,COL$reference,COL$reference,r=7)
  sc_text(s,30,96,"MEASURED IN MAMI",11.5,face="bold")
  sc_text(s,511,96,"EXTERNAL REFERENCE EVIDENCE",11.5,face="bold")
  sc_text(s,80,126,"Milk arsenic",10.5,face="bold",anchor="middle")
  sc_text(s,315,126,"Faecal genus (16S)",10.5,face="bold",anchor="middle")
  sc_text(s,652,126,"Human-gut representative",10.5,face="bold",anchor="middle")
  sc_text(s,932,126,"Candidate gene",10.5,face="bold",anchor="middle")
  sc_line(s,464,80,464,H-118,COL$rule,.8,"1,3")
  if(!nrow(a)) {
    sc_multiline(s,W/2,280,paste0("No associations meet BOTH criteria: ",FOLLOWUP_RULE," threshold and gene-reference support.\n",
      "Absence of a plotted path is not a gene-absence or null-association claim."),12,18,anchor="middle")
    return(list(scene=s,nodes=data.frame(),edges=data.frame()))
  }
  net <- network_geometry(a,s,page_map,page_candidates); nd <- net$nodes; ed <- net$edges
  from_idx <- match(ed$from,nd$id); to_idx <- match(ed$to,nd$id)
  if(anyNA(from_idx)||anyNA(to_idx)) stop("Network edge references a missing node.")
  # Multiple observed links use distinct ports on each box.
  port <- function(ids,step=7) {
    out <- numeric(length(ids))
    for(id in unique(ids)) {j<-which(ids==id);out[j]<-(seq_along(j)-(length(j)+1)/2)*step}
    out
  }
  dy0 <- port(ed$from,5); dy1 <- port(ed$to,5)
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(ed))) {
    ni <- from_idx[i]; nj <- to_idx[i]
    observed <- nzchar(ed$association_id[i])
    color <- if(observed) if(ed$rho[i]>0)COL$positive else COL$negative else COL$ref
    dash <- if(observed) if(ed$kind[i]=="FDR-supported association")"" else "5,3" else
      if(ed$kind[i] %in% c("Taxonomic reference link","Unresolved reference"))"1,3" else
      if(ed$kind[i]=="Annotation-only candidate")"5,3" else ""
    lw <- if(observed) .6+1.8*abs(ed$rho[i]) else .9
    sc_curve(s,nd$x[ni]+nd$width[ni]/2+2,nd$y[ni]+dy0[i],
      nd$x[nj]-nd$width[nj]/2-2,nd$y[nj]+dy1[i],color,lw,dash)
  }
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(nd))) {
    a1 <- nd[i,seq_len(ncol(nd)),drop=FALSE]
    stroke <- if(a1$type=="Observed genus")COL$ink else COL$rule
    sc_rect(s,a1$x-a1$width/2,a1$y-a1$height/2,a1$width,a1$height,COL$paper,stroke,.65,5)
    if(a1$type=="Human-gut representative") {
      r <- net$refs[match(a1$id,net$refs$id),seq_len(ncol(net$refs)),drop=FALSE]
      sc_multiline(s,a1$x,a1$y-12,wrap_label(a1$label,34),10.2,11.5,face="italic",anchor="middle")
      sc_text(s,a1$x,a1$y+9,r$species_rep,8.5,colour=COL$muted,anchor="middle")
      sc_text(s,a1$x,a1$y+21,r$evidence_label,
        7.6,colour=COL$muted,anchor="middle")
    } else if(a1$type=="Unresolved reference") {
      sc_multiline(s,a1$x,a1$y-8,"No exact genus match\nin the searched catalogue",10.2,13,anchor="middle")
      sc_text(s,a1$x,a1$y+18,"Not evidence of gene absence",8.3,colour=COL$muted,anchor="middle")
    } else if(a1$type=="Candidate gene") {
      sc_text(s,a1$x,a1$y-5,a1$label,13.5,face="italic",anchor="middle")
      sc_text(s,a1$x,a1$y+14,"reference only",8.5,colour=COL$muted,anchor="middle")
    } else {
      fontface <- if(a1$type=="Observed genus")"italic" else "bold"
      label <- wrap_label(a1$label,if(a1$type=="Observed genus")25L else 14L)
      sc_multiline(s,a1$x,a1$y,label,11,13,face=fontface,anchor="middle")
    }
  }
  if(!any(nd$type=="Candidate gene")) sc_multiline(s,932,(176+H-148)/2,
    "No candidate link\nin these annotations.\nNot a gene-absence claim.",9,13,colour=COL$muted,anchor="middle")
  fy <- H-91
  sc_line(s,25,fy,56,fy,COL$negative,1.7,"5,3");sc_text(s,64,fy,"Negative association",9.1)
  sc_line(s,227,fy,258,fy,COL$positive,1.7,"5,3");sc_text(s,266,fy,"Positive association",9.1)
  sc_line(s,430,fy,461,fy,COL$ref,.9,"1,3");sc_text(s,469,fy,"Taxonomic bridge (not observed species)",9.1)
  sc_line(s,766,fy,797,fy,COL$ref,.9,"5,3");sc_text(s,805,fy,"Annotation-only candidate",9.1)
  sc_text(s,24,H-64,"Observed edge width = |rho|. Dashed observed links: nominal p < 0.05; solid: q(all milk) < 0.05.",9,colour=COL$muted)
  sc_text(s,24,H-48,"Solid reference-gene links require passing homology; this is still candidate evidence, not functional proof.",9,colour=COL$muted)
  sc_text(s,24,H-32,if(REFERENCE_INCOMPLETE)"CAUTION: REFERENCE SCREEN INCOMPLETE. See attempted/completed/failed coverage counts." else
    "Full requested scope completed. All supported representatives/genes paginated; repeated cohort links are not replication.",9,colour=COL$muted)
  sc_text(s,24,H-16,"Effect sizes, bootstrap intervals, sample sizes and complete FDR scopes accompany the forest plot and exported tables.",9,colour=COL$muted)
  j <- match(ed$association_id,a$association_id)
  for(v in c("n","ci_low","ci_high","p","q_endpoint","q_group","q_all_milk")) ed[[v]] <- a[[v]][j]
  list(scene=s,nodes=nd,edges=ed)
}
plot_network <- function(gr) {
  a <- take_rows(plot_associations,plot_associations$group==gr)
  if(!nrow(a)) {
    message(gr, ": no network exported; no links meet both the statistical rule and reference-gene evidence rule.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  pages <- network_pages(a)
  for(i in seq_along(pages)) {
    obj <- network_scene(pages[[i]]$a,gr,i,length(pages),pages[[i]]$mapping,pages[[i]]$candidates)
    stem <- paste0("N_",tolower(gr),if(length(pages)>1L)sprintf("_p%02d",i)else "")
    write_csv(obj$nodes,paste0(stem,"_nodes"));write_csv(obj$edges,paste0(stem,"_edges"))
    save_scene(obj$scene,stem)
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
forest_scene <- function(d,gr,page,total,all_tests=FALSE) {
  W <- 1080; row_h <- 47; H <- max(330,210+max(1,nrow(d))*row_h)
  title <- paste(gr,if(all_tests)"milk-genus associations: complete tested family" else
    if(FOLLOWUP_RULE=="nominal")"nominal milk-genus links with reference-gene support" else
    "FDR-supported milk-genus links with reference-gene support")
  s <- scene_new(W,H,title)
  sc_text(s,20,26,title,17,face="bold")
  sc_text(s,20,50,paste0("Unadjusted Spearman effects | Pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals | Page ",page,"/",total),10,colour=COL$muted)
  if(!nrow(d)) {
    sc_multiline(s,W/2,160,"No eligible associations meet the configured selection rule.\nSee the complete primary test table; this is not an estimated null effect.",12,18,anchor="middle")
    return(s)
  }
  sc_rect(s,16,76,W-32,45,COL$study,COL$study,r=4)
  x0 <- 414; x1 <- 614
  xpos <- function(rho) x0+(rho+1)/2*(x1-x0)
  sc_text(s,25,97,"ID",10,face="bold")
  sc_multiline(s,72,97,"Milk\nendpoint",10,12,face="bold")
  sc_text(s,181,97,"Faecal genus",10,face="bold")
  sc_multiline(s,(x0+x1)/2,97,"Spearman rho\n(95% CI)",10,12,face="bold",anchor="middle")
  sc_text(s,659,97,"N",10,face="bold",anchor="middle")
  sc_text(s,760,97,"rho [95% CI]",10,face="bold",anchor="middle")
  sc_text(s,887,97,"p",10,face="bold",anchor="middle")
  sc_multiline(s,962,97,"q\n(endpoint)",10,12,face="bold",anchor="middle")
  sc_multiline(s,1040,97,"q\n(all milk)",10,12,face="bold",anchor="middle")
  bottom <- 121+nrow(d)*row_h
  for(t in c(-1,-.5,0,.5,1)) sc_line(s,xpos(t),121,xpos(t),bottom,
    if(t==0)COL$muted else COL$faint,if(t==0).8 else .6,if(t==0)"1,3" else "")
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(d))) {
    y <- 121+(i-.5)*row_h
    sc_line(s,20,121+i*row_h,W-20,121+i*row_h,COL$faint,.7)
    sc_text(s,25,y,d$association_id[i],9.2)
    sc_multiline(s,72,y,wrap_label(pretty_as(d$arsenic[i]),13),10,12)
    sc_multiline(s,181,y,wrap_label(pretty_genus(d$feature[i]),28),9.9,11.7,face="italic")
    col <- if(is.finite(d$rho[i]) && d$rho[i]>0)COL$positive else COL$negative
    if(is.finite(d$ci_low[i]) && is.finite(d$ci_high[i])) {
      lo <- max(-1,d$ci_low[i]); hi <- min(1,d$ci_high[i])
      sc_line(s,xpos(lo),y,xpos(hi),y,col,1.2)
      sc_line(s,xpos(lo),y-3,xpos(lo),y+3,col,.9)
      sc_line(s,xpos(hi),y-3,xpos(hi),y+3,col,.9)
    }
    if(is.finite(d$rho[i])) sc_circle(s,xpos(d$rho[i]),y,3.8,
      if(is.finite(d$q_all_milk[i]) && d$q_all_milk[i]<.05)col else COL$paper,col,1.2)
    ci <- if(is.finite(d$ci_low[i]) && is.finite(d$ci_high[i]))
      sprintf("%+.2f [%+.2f, %+.2f]",d$rho[i],d$ci_low[i],d$ci_high[i]) else
      if(is.finite(d$rho[i]))sprintf("%+.2f [CI unavailable]",d$rho[i]) else "Not estimated"
    sc_text(s,659,y,as.character(d$n[i]),10,anchor="middle")
    sc_text(s,760,y,ci,9.5,anchor="middle")
    sc_text(s,887,y,fmt_p(d$p[i]),10,anchor="middle")
    sc_text(s,962,y,fmt_p(d$q_endpoint[i]),10,anchor="middle")
    sc_text(s,1040,y,fmt_p(d$q_all_milk[i]),10,anchor="middle")
  }
  for(t in c(-1,-.5,0,.5,1)) sc_text(s,xpos(t),bottom+16,format(t),9,colour=COL$muted,anchor="middle")
  sc_text(s,20,H-52,"Open circles: not supported by milk-wide FDR. Filled circles: q(all milk) < 0.05. Nominal p is not FDR support.",9,colour=COL$muted)
  sc_text(s,20,H-36,"q(endpoint) covers genera within one endpoint/population; q(all milk) covers the full maternal + infant milk-only family.",9,colour=COL$muted)
  sc_text(s,20,H-20,"Intervals are pointwise and conditional on the retained CLR composition. Related arsenic sums are not independent replications.",9,colour=COL$muted)
  s
}
plot_forest <- function(gr,all_tests=FALSE) {
  d <- take_rows(if(all_tests)primary else plot_associations,
    if(all_tests)primary$group==gr else plot_associations$group==gr)
  if(!nrow(d) && !all_tests) return(invisible(NULL))
  if(nrow(d)) {
    d <- d[order(d$feature,d$arsenic),seq_len(ncol(d)),drop=FALSE]
    if(!"association_id" %in% names(d)) d$association_id <- sprintf("T%03d",seq_len(nrow(d)))
  }
  pages <- row_pages(d,12L)
  for(i in seq_along(pages)) {
    stem <- paste0(if(all_tests)"S_all_" else "F_",tolower(gr),
      if(length(pages)>1L)sprintf("_p%02d",i)else "")
    save_scene(forest_scene(pages[[i]],gr,i,length(pages),all_tests),stem)
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
write_html_gallery <- function() {
  reg <- bind_rows_safe(FIGURE_REGISTRY)
  html <- c('<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>MAMI module 07 figures</title>',
    '<style>body{font:16px Arial,sans-serif;max-width:1500px;margin:35px auto;padding:0 20px;color:#243744}',
    'section{margin:35px 0}svg{width:100%;height:auto}a{margin-right:16px}small{color:#5D6A72}</style></head><body>',
     '<h1>MAMI: milk arsenic and faecal-genus reference follow-up</h1>',
    paste0('<p><strong>Reference coverage: ',xml_escape(REFERENCE_STATUS),'</strong></p>'),
    '<p>Networks are paginated without top-N omissions. Repeated observed links across pages are the same test, not replication.</p>',
    '<p>Only statistical follow-up links with a gene candidate on a human-gut reference representative are shown. All tests, exclusions and original FDR values remain in the tables.</p>',
    paste0('<p>Statistical display rule: ',xml_escape(FOLLOWUP_RULE),
      '. Nominal p &lt; 0.05 is exploratory, not FDR significance. No participant gene carriage is established.</p>'))
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(display_selection$counts))) {
    d <- display_selection$counts[i,seq_len(ncol(display_selection$counts)),drop=FALSE]
    html <- c(html,paste0('<p><strong>',xml_escape(d$group),'</strong>: ',
      d$n_plotted_links,' supported plotted links of ',d$n_statistical_followup,
      ' statistically selected links; ',d$n_primary_tests,' primary tests retained. ',
      xml_escape(d$status),'.</p>'))
  }
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(reg))) {
    svg <- readLines(reg$svg[i],warn=FALSE,encoding="UTF-8")
    svg <- svg[!grepl("^<\\?xml",svg)]
    links <- paste0('<a href="figures/',xml_escape(basename(reg$svg[i])),'">Editable SVG</a>')
    if(!is.na(reg$pdf[i])) links <- paste0(links,'<a href="figures/',xml_escape(basename(reg$pdf[i])),'">Vector PDF</a>')
    if(!is.na(reg$png[i])) links <- paste0(links,'<a href="figures/',xml_escape(basename(reg$png[i])),'">',reg$png_dpi[i],' dpi PNG</a>')
    html <- c(html,paste0('<section><h2>',xml_escape(reg$title[i]),'</h2>',links),svg,
      paste0('<p><small>Export status: ',reg$status[i],'</small></p></section>'))
  }
  writeLines(c(html,'</body></html>'),file.path(ROOT,'GALLERY.html'),useBytes=TRUE)
  invisible(reg)
}
```

# Recompute milk–genus associations before selecting any candidates

```{r associations}
milk<-read_sheet("hm_arsenic")
milk$family_id<-std_family(milk$family_code)
milk$month<-as.integer(sub("^([0-9]+).*","\\1",trimws(milk$timepoint_month)))
milk$site<-tolower(trimws(milk$sample_site))
for(v in c("asb","as_iii","as_v","dma","mma"))milk[[v]]<-num(milk[[v]],v)
if(any(as.matrix(milk[seq_len(nrow(milk)),c("asb","as_iii","as_v","dma","mma")])<0,na.rm=TRUE))stop("Negative arsenic value.")
milk<-take_rows(milk,!is.na(milk$site)&milk$site=="milk"&!is.na(milk$month)&milk$month==MILK_MONTH)
if(anyNA(milk$family_id)||anyDuplicated(milk$family_id))stop("Milk family IDs must be nonmissing and unique within month.")
milk$ias<-milk$as_iii+milk$as_v
milk$methylated_as<-milk$mma+milk$dma
milk$non_asb_as<-milk$ias+milk$methylated_as
mi<-load_micro("genus_infant_1month","Infant")
ma<-load_micro("genus_mother_1month","Maternal")
res<-list(Maternal=run_group(ma,milk,"Maternal"),Infant=run_group(mi,milk,"Infant"))
effects<-bind_rows_safe(lapply(res,function(x)x$effects))
filtering<-bind_rows_safe(lapply(res,function(x)x$filtering))
eligibility<-bind_rows_safe(lapply(res,function(x)x$eligibility))
analysis_status<-bind_rows_safe(lapply(res,function(x)x$status))
if(nrow(effects)) {
  effects$q_endpoint<-effects$q_group<-effects$q_all_milk<-NA_real_
  for(method in unique(effects$method)) {
    ix<-which(effects$method==method);effects$q_all_milk[ix]<-bh(effects$p[ix])
    for(gr in unique(effects$group[ix])) {
      ig<-ix[effects$group[ix]==gr];effects$q_group[ig]<-bh(effects$p[ig])
      for(o in unique(effects$arsenic[ig])) {
        io<-ig[effects$arsenic[ig]==o];effects$q_endpoint[io]<-bh(effects$p[io])
      }
    }
  }
  primary<-take_rows(effects,effects$is_primary)
} else {
  primary<-data.frame(group=character(),milk_month=integer(),arsenic=character(),feature=character(),
     n=integer(),rho=numeric(),ci_low=numeric(),ci_high=numeric(),p=numeric(),q_all_milk=numeric(),
     q_group=numeric(),q_endpoint=numeric(),status=character())
}
select<-if(FOLLOWUP_RULE=="nominal")is.finite(primary$p)&primary$p<.05 else
  is.finite(primary$q_all_milk)&primary$q_all_milk<.05
associations<-take_rows(primary,select)
associations$association_id<-sprintf("A%03d",seq_len(nrow(associations)))
associations$evidence<-ifelse(is.finite(associations$q_all_milk)&associations$q_all_milk<.05,
                            "FDR-supported association","Nominal association")
write_csv(effects,"01_all_associations_and_sensitivities")
write_csv(primary,"02_primary_all_milk_tests")
write_csv(associations,"03_followup_associations")
write_csv(filtering,"04_complete_subset_filtering")
write_csv(eligibility,"05_eligible_samples_PRIVATE")
write_csv(analysis_status,"06_analysis_status")
write_csv(rbind(ma$qc,mi$qc),"07_raw_count_QC_PRIVATE")
knitr::kable(analysis_status,caption="Eligible subsets; one-month maternal and infant stool, analysed separately")
```

**Inference:** all retained genera are tested before selecting the network.
`q_endpoint` corrects taxa within one arsenic endpoint and population; `q_group`
corrects all six endpoints in one population; `q_all_milk` corrects all tested
milk–genus links in both populations. Each pseudocount and raw-RA sensitivity has
its own complete family. The old module also tested urine, so its module-wide
q-values are not interchangeable with this explicitly milk-only family. All
analyses are exploratory, unadjusted Spearman associations. Bootstrap intervals
are pointwise and conditional on the fixed eligible set, retained taxa and CLR.

# Reviewed sequence-query snapshot (not a frozen genome inventory)

```{r reviewed-query-snapshot, include=FALSE}
snapshot_table <- function(lines) {
  read.delim(text=paste(lines,collapse="\n"),sep="\t",quote="",comment.char="",
    colClasses="character",check.names=FALSE,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}
MARKERS <- snapshot_table(c(
  "gene\tprocess\tgroup",
  "arsM\tArsenic methylation\tMethylation",
  "aioA\tArsenite oxidation\tOxidation",
  "aioB\tArsenite oxidation\tOxidation",
  "arrA\tRespiratory arsenate reduction\tRespiratory reduction",
  "arrB\tRespiratory arsenate reduction\tRespiratory reduction",
```

# Catalogue download, normalization and reference-screen functions

```{r full-catalogue-functions, include=FALSE}
# Full UHGG catalogue: resumable public-reference I/O and auditable name matching.
# Statistical thresholds are NEVER selected using these reference results.
CATALOGUE_ENGINE_VERSION <- "UHGG202_allrep_safe_taxonomy_v1"
UHGG_BASE <- paste0("https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/metagenomics/",
                    "mgnify_genomes/human-gut/v2.0.2")
UHGG_METADATA_URL <- paste0(UHGG_BASE,"/genomes-all_metadata.tsv")
ref_url <- function(id,suffix) {
  paste0(UHGG_BASE,"/species_catalogue/",substr(id,1,11),"/",id,"/genome/",id,suffix)
}
canonical_taxon <- function(x) {
  # Formatting only. Meaningful letters/digits, GTDB suffixes, R-7 and UCG codes remain.
  x <- trimws(as.character(x)); x[is.na(x)] <- ""
  x <- gsub("\u00a0"," ",x,fixed=TRUE)
  x <- tolower(iconv(x,from="",to="ASCII//TRANSLIT",sub=""))
  x[is.na(x)] <- ""
  x <- sub("^(g|s)_+","",x)
  gsub("[^a-z0-9]","",x)
}
rank_value <- function(x,rank) {
  vapply(strsplit(as.character(x),";",fixed=TRUE),function(parts) {
    hit <- parts[startsWith(parts,paste0(rank,"__"))]
    if(length(hit)) sub(paste0("^",rank,"__"),"",hit[1]) else ""
  },character(1))
}
marker_symbols <- function(x,genes) {
  # An annotation symbol, not an arbitrary description/domain, is required.
  if(length(x)!=1L || is.na(x) || !nzchar(trimws(x))) return(character())
  if(grepl("family|domain|like|putative|regulator of",x,ignore.case=TRUE)) return(character())
  pieces <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(x,"[;,|/]")))
  key <- function(y) gsub("[^a-z0-9]","",tolower(y))
  unique(genes[key(genes) %in% key(pieces)])
}
annotation_matches <- function(preferred,gene) {
  if(length(preferred)!=length(gene)) stop("Annotation vector lengths differ")
  vapply(seq_along(gene),function(i) {
    !is.na(gene[i]) && gene[i] %in% marker_symbols(preferred[i],MARKERS$gene)
  },logical(1))
}
header_key <- function(x) gsub("[^a-z0-9]","",tolower(x))
atomic_rds <- function(object,path) {
  tmp <- paste0(path,".partial");saveRDS(object,tmp)
  if(file.exists(path))unlink(path)
  if(!file.rename(tmp,path))stop("Cannot commit cache checkpoint: ",path)
  invisible(path)
}
DOWNLOAD_LOG <- list()
cache_roots <- function() {
  roots <- c(REFERENCE_CACHE,LEGACY_REFERENCE_CACHE)
  unique(roots[nzchar(roots) & dir.exists(roots)])
}

ref_file_ok <- function(path,type) {
  if(!file.exists(path) || is.na(file.info(path)$size) || file.info(path)$size<8)return(FALSE)
  h <- tryCatch(readLines(path,n=30L,warn=FALSE,encoding="UTF-8"),error=function(e)character())
  if(!length(h) || any(grepl("^\\s*<(html|!doctype)|Access denied",h,ignore.case=TRUE)))return(FALSE)
  if(type=="fasta")return(startsWith(h[1],">"))
  if(type=="metadata")return(all(c("Genome","Species_rep","Lineage") %in% strsplit(h[1],"\t",fixed=TRUE)[[1]]))
  if(type=="annotation")return(any(grepl("^#?query\t",h)&grepl("Preferred_name",h,fixed=TRUE)))
  FALSE
}
fetch_reference <- function(url,dest,type,force=FALSE) {
  dir.create(dirname(dest),recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
  addlog <- function(status,detail="") {
    bytes <- if(file.exists(dest))unname(file.info(dest)$size)else NA_real_
    md5 <- if(file.exists(dest))unname(tools::md5sum(dest))else NA_character_
    DOWNLOAD_LOG[[length(DOWNLOAD_LOG)+1L]] <<- data.frame(url=url,path=dest,type=type,
      status=status,bytes=bytes,md5=md5,checked_at=as.character(Sys.time()),detail=detail)
  }
  if(!force && ref_file_ok(dest,type)) {addlog("validated_local_cache");return(dest)}
  if(!force) {
    roots <- cache_roots(); bn <- basename(dest)
    subdir <- switch(type,metadata="uhgg",annotation="annotations",fasta="proteomes")
    possible <- unique(c(file.path(roots,bn),file.path(roots,subdir,bn)))
    for(p in possible)if(ref_file_ok(p,type)) {
      if(!file.copy(p,dest,overwrite=TRUE))next
      if(unname(tools::md5sum(p))!=unname(tools::md5sum(dest)))stop("Cache-copy checksum mismatch")
      addlog("copied_validated_cache",p);return(dest)
    }
  }
  if(OFFLINE_REFERENCES) {addlog("unavailable_offline");stop("Reference unavailable offline: ",basename(dest))}
  old <- getOption("timeout");options(timeout=max(900,old));on.exit(options(timeout=old),add=TRUE)
  tmp <- paste0(dest,".partial");on.exit(unlink(tmp),add=TRUE)
  errors <- character()
  for(attempt in seq_len(DOWNLOAD_ATTEMPTS)) {
    if(file.exists(tmp))unlink(tmp)
    ok <- tryCatch({
      if(requireNamespace("curl",quietly=TRUE)) {
        h <- curl::new_handle(connecttimeout=30,timeout=if(type=="metadata")900 else 180,
                              followlocation=TRUE,failonerror=TRUE)
        curl::curl_download(url,tmp,quiet=TRUE,mode="wb",handle=h)
      } else {
        status <- utils::download.file(url,tmp,mode="wb",method="libcurl",quiet=TRUE)
        if(!identical(as.integer(status),0L))stop("download.file returned ",status)
      }
      if(!ref_file_ok(tmp,type))stop("Downloaded file does not have the required format")
      TRUE
    },error=function(e){errors <<- c(errors,conditionMessage(e));FALSE})
    if(ok) {
      if(!file.copy(tmp,dest,overwrite=TRUE))stop("Cannot save reference: ",dest)
      addlog("downloaded",paste("attempt",attempt));return(dest)
    }
    if(attempt<DOWNLOAD_ATTEMPTS)Sys.sleep(min(4,attempt))
  }
  addlog("failed",paste(unique(errors),collapse=" | "))
  stop("Reference download failed: ",basename(dest),"; ",paste(unique(errors),collapse=" | "))
}
flush_downloads <- function()write_csv(bind_rows_safe(DOWNLOAD_LOG),"26_reference_download_manifest")

load_catalogue <- function(path) {
  md <- data.table::fread(path,sep="\t",header=TRUE,quote="",data.table=FALSE,
                         colClasses="character",na.strings=c("","NA","-"),showProgress=FALSE)
  need <- c("Genome","Species_rep","Lineage","Completeness","Contamination","Sample_accession")
  if(!all(need%in%names(md)))stop("Unexpected UHGG metadata schema: ",paste(setdiff(need,names(md)),collapse=", "))
  if(anyNA(md$Genome)||anyNA(md$Species_rep)||anyDuplicated(md$Genome))stop("Invalid/nonunique genome IDs in metadata")
  ids <- sort(unique(md$Species_rep));j <- match(ids,md$Genome)
  if(anyNA(j))stop("Some species representatives have no metadata row")
  rr <- take_rows(md,j)
  if(any(rr$Genome!=rr$Species_rep))stop("Representative identities do not reconcile")
  if(!all(grepl("^MGYG[0-9]{9}(\\.[0-9]+)?$",ids)))stop("Unexpected representative accession format")
  counts <- table(md$Species_rep)
  sam <- aggregate(md$Sample_accession,by=list(species_rep=md$Species_rep),
    FUN=function(x)length(unique(x[!is.na(x)&nzchar(x)])))
  d <- data.frame(species_rep=ids,gtdb_genus=rank_value(rr$Lineage,"g"),
    gtdb_species=rank_value(rr$Lineage,"s"),gtdb_family=rank_value(rr$Lineage,"f"),
    lineage=rr$Lineage,n_genomes_in_cluster=as.integer(counts[ids]),
    n_source_samples=sam$x[match(ids,sam$species_rep)],
    completeness=suppressWarnings(as.numeric(rr$Completeness)),
    contamination=suppressWarnings(as.numeric(rr$Contamination)),
    catalogue_version="UHGG_v2.0.2",stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  d$genus_key <- canonical_taxon(d$gtdb_genus)
  gc <- table(d$genus_key)
  d$genus_representatives_in_catalogue <- as.integer(gc[d$genus_key])
  d$annotation_url <- vapply(ids,ref_url,character(1),suffix="_eggNOG.tsv")
  d$proteome_url <- vapply(ids,ref_url,character(1),suffix=".faa")
  audit <- data.frame(metadata_rows=nrow(md),species_clusters=length(ids),
    representative_rows=nrow(d),metadata_md5=unname(tools::md5sum(path)),
    catalogue_version="UHGG_v2.0.2",metadata_path=path,
    metadata_url=UHGG_METADATA_URL,checked_at=as.character(Sys.time()),
    scope="Every species representative; not all constituent strains")
  list(representatives=d,audit=audit)
}
empty_mapping <- function()data.frame(feature=character(),species_rep=character(),
  gtdb_genus=character(),gtdb_species=character(),link_type=character(),status=character(),
  mapping_source=character(),mapping_basis=character(),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
empty_suggestions <- function()data.frame(feature=character(),source_label=character(),
  target_rank=character(),target_name=character(),reason=character(),
  approved=logical(),evidence_url=character(),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
match_catalogue <- function(features,catalogue,crosswalk=NULL) {
  maps <- list();suggest <- list();features <- sort(unique(features))
  if(!is.null(crosswalk)&&nrow(crosswalk)) {
    required <- c("source_label","target_rank","target_name","approved","evidence_url")
    if(!all(required%in%names(crosswalk)))stop("Crosswalk requires: ",paste(required,collapse=", "))
    approved <- tolower(trimws(as.character(crosswalk$approved)))%in%c("true","1","yes")
    crosswalk <- take_rows(crosswalk,approved)
    if(nrow(crosswalk)&&any(is.na(crosswalk$evidence_url)|!grepl("^https?://|^doi:",crosswalk$evidence_url)))
      stop("Every approved taxonomy crosswalk needs a supporting URL or DOI")
    if(any(!crosswalk$target_rank%in%c("genus","species","representative")))stop("Invalid crosswalk target rank")
  }
  for(tax in features) {
    key <- canonical_taxon(tax);ix <- which(nzchar(key)&catalogue$genus_key==key)
    kind <- "Formatting-normalized genus";src <- UHGG_METADATA_URL;basis <- "Case/spacing/punctuation only"
    one <- list()
    append_map <- function(j,kind,source,basis) {
      if(length(j))one[[length(one)+1L]] <<- data.frame(feature=tax,
        species_rep=catalogue$species_rep[j],gtdb_genus=catalogue$gtdb_genus[j],
        gtdb_species=catalogue$gtdb_species[j],link_type=kind,
        status="Human-gut catalogue representative available",mapping_source=source,mapping_basis=basis)
    }
    append_map(ix,kind,src,basis)
    # Composite 16S labels remain explicitly composite; no species is inferred.
    if(key=="escherichiashigella")append_map(which(catalogue$genus_key%in%c("escherichia","shigella")),
      "Composite 16S proxy","https://gtdb.ecogenomic.org/faq",
      "Escherichia-Shigella composite label; NOT observed species identity")
    if(!is.null(crosswalk)&&nrow(crosswalk)) {
      cw <- take_rows(crosswalk,canonical_taxon(crosswalk$source_label)==key)
      for(k in seq_len(nrow(cw))) {
        vals <- switch(cw$target_rank[k],genus=catalogue$gtdb_genus,
                       species=catalogue$gtdb_species,representative=catalogue$species_rep)
        hit <- which(canonical_taxon(vals)==canonical_taxon(cw$target_name[k]))
        if(!length(hit))warning("Approved crosswalk target absent in pinned catalogue: ",cw$target_name[k])
        append_map(hit,"Documented crosswalk",cw$evidence_url[k],
                   paste(cw$source_label[k],"to",cw$target_rank[k],cw$target_name[k]))
      }
    }
    d <- bind_rows_safe(one,empty_mapping())
    if(nrow(d))d <- take_rows(d,!duplicated(d$species_rep))
    if(!nrow(d)) {
      d <- data.frame(feature=tax,species_rep=NA_character_,gtdb_genus=NA_character_,
        gtdb_species=NA_character_,link_type="Unresolved",status="No supported taxonomic bridge; not gene absence",
        mapping_source=UHGG_METADATA_URL,mapping_basis="No automatic fuzzy/group/suffix collapse")
      # Suggestions are deliberately NOT used by the scientific mapping or plots.
      gn <- unique(catalogue$gtdb_genus[nzchar(catalogue$gtdb_genus)])
      distance <- as.numeric(utils::adist(key,canonical_taxon(gn)))
      ord <- head(order(distance,gn),5L)
      if(length(ord))suggest[[length(suggest)+1L]] <- data.frame(feature=tax,source_label=tax,
        target_rank="genus",target_name=gn[ord],reason=paste0("Lexical suggestion only; edit distance ",distance[ord]),
        approved=FALSE,evidence_url="")
      # Named species-group epithet: a review hint, NOT a species-level match.
      label <- gsub("_"," ",sub("^g_+","",tolower(tax)))
      tokens <- strsplit(trimws(sub(" group$","",label))," +")[[1]]
      if(length(tokens)>=2L) {
        ep <- tokens[length(tokens)]
        si <- which(grepl(paste0(" ",ep,"($|_[A-Z]+$)"),catalogue$gtdb_species,ignore.case=TRUE))
        if(length(si))suggest[[length(suggest)+1L]]<-data.frame(feature=tax,source_label=tax,
          target_rank="species",target_name=unique(catalogue$gtdb_species[si]),
          reason="Species-name resemblance only: 16S group membership needs evidence",approved=FALSE,evidence_url="")
      }
    }
    maps[[length(maps)+1L]] <- d
  }
  list(mapping=bind_rows_safe(maps,empty_mapping()),suggestions=bind_rows_safe(suggest,empty_suggestions()))
}
empty_annotation <- function()data.frame(species_rep=character(),protein_id=character(),gene=character(),
  preferred_name=character(),description=character(),kegg_ko=character(),annotation_md5=character(),
  annotation_url=character(),annotation_match=character(),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
parse_annotation <- function(path,sg) {
  h <- readLines(path,n=50L,warn=FALSE,encoding="UTF-8")
  k <- which(grepl("^#?query\t",h)&grepl("Preferred_name",h,fixed=TRUE))
  if(!length(k))stop("eggNOG header not found")
  rr <- data.table::fread(path,skip=k[1]-1L,header=TRUE,sep="\t",quote="",data.table=FALSE,
    colClasses="character",na.strings=c("","-","NA"),showProgress=FALSE)
  names(rr) <- header_key(names(rr))
  if(!all(c("query","preferredname","description")%in%names(rr)))stop("Required eggNOG columns absent")
  if(nrow(rr)&&any(is.na(rr$query)|!startsWith(rr$query,paste0(sg,"_"))|duplicated(rr$query)))
    stop("eggNOG protein IDs are missing, duplicated or from a different representative")
  matches <- lapply(rr$preferredname,marker_symbols,genes=MARKERS$gene)
  take <- which(lengths(matches)>0L);out <- list();md5 <- unname(tools::md5sum(path))
  for(i in take) {
    genes <- matches[[i]];n <- length(genes)
    out[[length(out)+1L]]<-data.frame(species_rep=rep(sg,n),protein_id=rep(rr$query[i],n),gene=genes,
      preferred_name=rep(rr$preferredname[i],n),description=rep(rr$description[i],n),
      kegg_ko=rep(if("keggko"%in%names(rr))rr$keggko[i]else NA_character_,n),
      annotation_md5=rep(md5,n),annotation_url=rep(ref_url(sg,"_eggNOG.tsv"),n),
      annotation_match=rep("Preferred gene symbol; case/spacing/punctuation normalized",n))
  }
  list(hits=bind_rows_safe(out,empty_annotation()),n_proteins=nrow(rr),md5=md5)
}
screen_annotation <- function(sg) {
  dest <- file.path(REFERENCE_CACHE,"annotations",paste0(sg,"_eggNOG.tsv"))
  checkpoint <- file.path(REFERENCE_CACHE,"parsed",paste0(sg,"_annotation.rds"))
  for(attempt in 1:2) {
    ans <- tryCatch({
      path <- fetch_reference(ref_url(sg,"_eggNOG.tsv"),dest,"annotation",force=attempt>1L)
      checksum <- unname(tools::md5sum(path))
      cached <- if(file.exists(checkpoint))tryCatch(readRDS(checkpoint),error=function(e)NULL)else NULL
      if(!is.null(cached)&&identical(cached$engine,CATALOGUE_ENGINE_VERSION)&&identical(cached$md5,checksum)) {
        parsed <- cached
      } else {
        parsed <- parse_annotation(path,sg);parsed$engine <- CATALOGUE_ENGINE_VERSION
        atomic_rds(parsed,checkpoint)
      }
      list(ok=TRUE,hits=parsed$hits,n_proteins=parsed$n_proteins,md5=checksum,detail="Parsed successfully")
    },error=function(e)list(ok=FALSE,hits=empty_annotation(),n_proteins=NA_integer_,
                           md5=NA_character_,detail=conditionMessage(e)))
    if(ans$ok||OFFLINE_REFERENCES)break
  }
  ans
}
```

# Early BLAST self-test before catalogue downloads

```{r early-blast-control, include=FALSE}
# Fail before thousands of downloads if the explicitly requested executable cannot run.
if(RUN_BLAST) {
  if(!length(BLASTP)||!nzchar(BLASTP)||!file.exists(BLASTP))
    stop("RUN_BLAST=TRUE, but blastp.exe was not found. Set BLASTP to the installed executable.")
  BLASTP <- normalizePath(BLASTP,winslash="/",mustWork=TRUE)
  early_blast_control <- function() {
    old <- getwd();on.exit(setwd(old),add=TRUE)
    setwd(BLAST_WORK)
    writeLines(c(paste0(">",QUERY_PROTEINS$query_id[1]),QUERY_PROTEINS$sequence[1]),"control.faa")
    if(file.exists("control.tsv"))unlink("control.tsv")
    log <- suppressWarnings(system2(BLASTP,args=c("-query","control.faa","-subject","control.faa",
      "-evalue","1e-10","-max_hsps","1","-outfmt",shQuote("6 pident length qlen"),
      "-out","control.tsv"),stdout=TRUE,stderr=TRUE))
    status <- attr(log,"status");if(is.null(status))status <- 0L
    writeLines(log,file.path(ROOT,"logs","BLAST_EARLY_PREFLIGHT.txt"))
    if(status!=0L||!file.exists("control.tsv")||file.info("control.tsv")$size==0L)
      stop("BLAST early self-alignment failed. See logs/BLAST_EARLY_PREFLIGHT.txt; no catalogue downloads started.")
    d <- read.delim("control.tsv",header=FALSE,sep="\t")
    if(ncol(d)!=3L||!any(d[[1]]>=99.9 & d[[2]]/d[[3]]>=.99))
      stop("BLAST self-alignment failed the expected identity/coverage checks")
    message("BLAST executable and short-file self-alignment check passed.")
  }
  early_blast_control()
}
```

# Actual BLAST sequence screen and reference evidence reconciliation

The default requests all species representative proteomes. Partial runs are reported
as partial; unsearched genes/proteomes are not negative. Within-species pan-genome or
strain carriage is not estimated from a single representative. Sequence homology and
computational annotation are candidate evidence, not experimental enzyme activity.

```{r full-catalogue-blast, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# Homology uses actual public representative proteomes. Every requested search is audited.
blast_log <- data.frame(species_rep=character(),completed=logical(),hits=integer(),
  query_md5=character(),subject_md5=character(),executable_md5=character(),detail=character())
blast_hits <- data.frame(query_id=character(),protein_id=character(),pident=numeric(),
  alignment_length=integer(),query_length=integer(),subject_length=integer(),evalue=numeric(),
  bitscore=numeric(),qstart=integer(),qend=integer(),sstart=integer(),send=integer(),
  species_rep=character(),gene=character(),accession=character(),qcoverage=numeric(),scoverage=numeric())
blast_ids <- if(BLAST_SCOPE=="all_representatives")REF_GENOMES$species_rep else unique(valid_map$species_rep)
blast_ids <- unique(c(intersect(valid_map$species_rep,blast_ids),sort(blast_ids)))
read_blast <- function(path,sg) {
  if(!file.exists(path))stop("BLAST did not create the requested output file")
  if(file.info(path)$size==0L)return(take_rows(blast_hits,integer(0)))
  d <- read.delim(path,header=FALSE,sep="\t",quote="",stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  if(ncol(d)!=12L)stop("Unexpected BLAST tabular schema")
  names(d) <- names(blast_hits)[1:12]
  for(v in names(d)[3:12])d[[v]] <- num(d[[v]],v)
  j <- match(d$query_id,QUERY_PROTEINS$query_id)
  if(anyNA(j))stop("Unknown BLAST query ID; stale result rejected")
  if(any(!is.finite(d$pident)|d$pident<0|d$pident>100|d$query_length<=0|d$subject_length<=0))
    stop("Invalid BLAST alignment values")
  d$species_rep <- rep(sg,nrow(d));d$gene <- QUERY_PROTEINS$gene[j];d$accession <- QUERY_PROTEINS$accession[j]
  d$qcoverage <- (abs(d$qend-d$qstart)+1)/d$query_length
  d$scoverage <- (abs(d$send-d$sstart)+1)/d$subject_length
  if(any(d$qcoverage>1.000001|d$scoverage>1.000001))stop("Invalid alignment coverage")
  d
}
run_local_blast <- function(qfile,sfile,outfile) {
  log <- suppressWarnings(system2(BLASTP,args=c("-query",qfile,"-subject",sfile,
    "-evalue","1e-10","-max_target_seqs","1000000","-max_hsps","1","-num_threads",as.character(BLAST_THREADS),
    "-outfmt",shQuote(paste("6 qseqid sseqid pident length qlen slen",
      "evalue bitscore qstart qend sstart send")),"-out",outfile),stdout=TRUE,stderr=TRUE))
  code <- attr(log,"status");if(is.null(code))code <- 0L
  if(code!=0L)stop(paste(log,collapse=" | "))
  log
}
run_blast_catalogue <- function(ids) {
  if(!length(BLASTP)||!nzchar(BLASTP)||!file.exists(BLASTP))stop("RUN_BLAST=TRUE but blastp is unavailable")
  BLASTP <<- normalizePath(BLASTP,winslash="/",mustWork=TRUE)
  job <- normalizePath(BLAST_WORK,winslash="/",mustWork=TRUE)
  oldwd <- getwd();on.exit(setwd(oldwd),add=TRUE);setwd(job)
  if(.Platform$OS.type=="windows"&&nchar(job)>150L)stop("Use a short local ROOT for BLAST")
  version <- system2(BLASTP,"-version",stdout=TRUE,stderr=TRUE)
  version_code <- attr(version,"status")
  if(!is.null(version_code)&&version_code!=0L)stop("blastp version test failed")
  writeLines(version,file.path(ROOT,"logs","BLAST_version.txt"))
  query_lines <- unlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(QUERY_PROTEINS)),function(i)
    c(paste0(">",QUERY_PROTEINS$query_id[i]),QUERY_PROTEINS$sequence[i])),use.names=FALSE)
  writeLines(query_lines,"query.faa",useBytes=TRUE)
  writeLines(c(paste0(">",QUERY_PROTEINS$query_id[1]),QUERY_PROTEINS$sequence[1]),"self.faa")
  if(file.exists("self.tsv"))unlink("self.tsv")
  run_local_blast("self.faa","self.faa","self.tsv")
  control <- read_blast("self.tsv","positive_control")
  if(!nrow(control)||!any(control$pident>=99.9&control$qcoverage>=.99&control$scoverage>=.99))
    stop("BLAST self-alignment control failed")
  qmd5 <- unname(tools::md5sum("query.faa"));emd5 <- unname(tools::md5sum(BLASTP))
  logs <- list();parts <- list();consecutive_failures <- 0L
  for(i in seq_along(ids)) {
    sg <- ids[i];smd5 <- NA_character_
    one <- tryCatch({
      dest <- file.path(REFERENCE_CACHE,"proteomes",paste0(sg,".faa"))
      source <- fetch_reference(ref_url(sg,".faa"),dest,"fasta")
      # Validate ALL subject IDs and sequence characters before using a cached alignment.
      seq_lines <- readLines(source,warn=FALSE)
      headers <- sub("^>","",seq_lines[startsWith(seq_lines,">")])
      headers <- sub("[[:space:]].*$","",headers)
      body <- seq_lines[!startsWith(seq_lines,">")&nzchar(seq_lines)]
      if(!length(headers)||any(!startsWith(headers,paste0(sg,"_")))||anyDuplicated(headers)||
         !length(body)||any(!grepl("^[ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWYBXZJUO*]+$",toupper(body))))
        stop("Invalid subject FASTA contents or representative-specific protein IDs")
      smd5 <- unname(tools::md5sum(source))
      signature <- list(query_md5=qmd5,subject_md5=smd5,executable_md5=emd5,
        version=paste(version,collapse=" | "),evalue=1e-10,outfmt=12L,max_hsps=1L,
        max_target_seqs=1000000L,release="M07_full_catalogue_blast_v1")
      out <- file.path(REFERENCE_CACHE,"blast",paste0(sg,".tsv"))
      stamp <- paste0(out,".rds")
      previous <- if(file.exists(stamp))tryCatch(readRDS(stamp),error=function(e)NULL)else NULL
      reused <- !is.null(previous)&&identical(previous$signature,signature)&&file.exists(out)&&
        identical(previous$output_md5,unname(tools::md5sum(out)))
      if(reused) {
        d <- read_blast(out,sg)
      } else {
        if(!file.copy(source,"subject.faa",overwrite=TRUE))stop("Could not stage subject FASTA")
        if(unname(tools::md5sum("subject.faa"))!=smd5)stop("Staged subject checksum mismatch")
        if(file.exists("result.tsv"))unlink("result.tsv")
        command_log <- run_local_blast("query.faa","subject.faa","result.tsv")
        writeLines(command_log,file.path(ROOT,"logs",paste0(sg,"_blast.txt")))
        d <- read_blast("result.tsv",sg)
        if(!file.copy("result.tsv",out,overwrite=TRUE))stop("Cannot save successful BLAST result")
        atomic_rds(list(signature=signature,output_md5=unname(tools::md5sum(out))),stamp)
      }
      if(nrow(d)&&any(!d$protein_id%in%headers))stop("Alignment target is absent from the subject FASTA")
      list(ok=TRUE,hits=d,detail=if(reused)"Completed; fingerprint-validated BLAST cache"else"Sequence search completed")
    },error=function(e)list(ok=FALSE,hits=take_rows(blast_hits,integer(0)),detail=conditionMessage(e)))
    logs[[length(logs)+1L]]<-data.frame(species_rep=sg,completed=one$ok,hits=nrow(one$hits),
      query_md5=qmd5,subject_md5=smd5,executable_md5=emd5,detail=one$detail)
    parts[[length(parts)+1L]] <- one$hits
    consecutive_failures <- if(one$ok)0L else consecutive_failures+1L
    if(consecutive_failures>=8L) {
      write_csv(bind_rows_safe(logs,blast_log),"12_BLAST_execution");flush_downloads()
      stop("Eight consecutive requested BLAST failures. No completion receipt is written; ",
           "inspect 12_BLAST_execution.csv. Successful fingerprinted jobs remain cached.")
    }
    if(i==1L||i%%10L==0L||i==length(ids)) {
      write_csv(bind_rows_safe(logs,blast_log),"12_BLAST_execution");flush_downloads()
      message("BLAST: ",i,"/",length(ids)," attempted; ",sum(vapply(logs,function(x)x$completed,logical(1)))," completed.")
    }
  }
  list(log=bind_rows_safe(logs,blast_log),hits=bind_rows_safe(parts,blast_hits))
}
if(RUN_BLAST&&length(blast_ids)) {
  bb <- run_blast_catalogue(blast_ids);blast_log <- bb$log;blast_hits <- bb$hits
} else {
  blast_log <- data.frame(species_rep=blast_ids,completed=rep(FALSE,length(blast_ids)),

    subject_md5=rep(NA_character_,length(blast_ids)),executable_md5=rep(NA_character_,length(blast_ids)),
    detail=rep("Not requested; annotation-only execution",length(blast_ids)))
}
write_csv(blast_log,"12_BLAST_execution");write_csv(blast_hits,"13_all_BLAST_alignments")
pass <- take_rows(blast_hits,is.finite(blast_hits$evalue)&blast_hits$evalue<=1e-10&
  blast_hits$pident>=35&blast_hits$qcoverage>=.70&blast_hits$scoverage>=.60)

passed <- paste(pass$species_rep,pass$protein_id,pass$gene,sep="|")
pass <- take_rows(pass,!duplicated(passed))

if(nrow(REFERENCE_GENES)) {

REFERENCE_GENES$functional_confirmation <- rep(FALSE,nrow(REFERENCE_GENES))

write_csv(candidates,"15_candidate_reference_gene_links")
flush_downloads()
# A missing query is not a negative sequence search for that marker.
query_coverage <- data.frame(gene=MARKERS$gene,
  n_reviewed_queries=vapply(MARKERS$gene,function(g)sum(QUERY_PROTEINS$gene==g),integer(1)))
```
