```{r full-catalogue-blast, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# Per-representative/per-marker statuses retain incomplete vs negative distinctions.
marker_calls <- expand.grid(species_rep=REF_GENOMES$species_rep,gene=MARKERS$gene,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
aidx <- match(marker_calls$species_rep,annotation_manifest$species_rep)
bidx <- match(marker_calls$species_rep,blast_log$species_rep)
marker_calls$annotation_completed <- !is.na(aidx)&!is.na(annotation_manifest$completed[aidx])&annotation_manifest$completed[aidx]
marker_calls$blast_completed <- RUN_BLAST & !is.na(bidx)&!is.na(blast_log$completed[bidx])&blast_log$completed[bidx]
marker_calls$marker_has_query <- query_coverage$homology_assessable[match(marker_calls$gene,query_coverage$gene)]
ck <- paste(marker_calls$species_rep,marker_calls$gene,sep="|")
ak <- paste(REF_HITS$species_rep,REF_HITS$gene,sep="|")
hk <- paste(pass$species_rep,pass$gene,sep="|")
marker_calls$annotation_candidate <- ck%in%ak
marker_calls$homology_candidate <- ck%in%hk
marker_calls$status <- ifelse(marker_calls$annotation_candidate|marker_calls$homology_candidate,
  "Candidate detected: inspect protein-level evidence",
  ifelse(marker_calls$annotation_completed&marker_calls$blast_completed&marker_calls$marker_has_query,
    "Not detected in this representative under this screen",
    ifelse(marker_calls$annotation_completed,"No annotation candidate; sequence evidence unassessed/incomplete",
           "Reference evidence unassessed/incomplete")))
write_csv(marker_calls,"30_all_representative_marker_screen_status")
coverage_summary <- data.frame(
 metric=c("Catalogue genomes in metadata","All species representatives","Annotation files requested",
          "Annotation files completed","Annotation files failed","Taxonomically mapped representatives",
          "BLAST searches requested","BLAST searches completed","BLAST searches failed",
          "Reference proteins with any candidate evidence"),
 value=c(catalogue_audit$metadata_rows,nrow(REF_GENOMES),nrow(annotation_manifest),
         sum(annotation_manifest$completed),sum(!annotation_manifest$completed),
         length(unique(valid_map$species_rep)),if(RUN_BLAST)length(blast_ids)else 0L,
         if(RUN_BLAST)sum(blast_log$completed)else 0L,
         if(RUN_BLAST)sum(!blast_log$completed)else 0L,
         length(unique(paste(REFERENCE_GENES$species_rep,REFERENCE_GENES$protein_id)))))
write_csv(coverage_summary,"31_reference_search_coverage")
REFERENCE_INCOMPLETE <- any(!annotation_manifest$completed) || (RUN_BLAST&&any(!blast_log$completed))
REFERENCE_STATUS <- if(REFERENCE_INCOMPLETE)"INCOMPLETE reference search: inspect coverage/failed downloads"else
  paste0("Completed requested scope: annotations=",ANNOTATION_SCOPE,"; BLAST=",if(RUN_BLAST)BLAST_SCOPE else "not requested")
writeLines(REFERENCE_STATUS,file.path(ROOT,"logs","REFERENCE_COVERAGE_STATUS.txt"))
if(REFERENCE_INCOMPLETE)warning(REFERENCE_STATUS,". Partial data are never labelled exhaustive or negative.")
knitr::kable(coverage_summary,caption="Full-catalogue coverage: attempted/completed/failed are distinct")

```

# Display gate: statistical follow-up AND human-gut gene-reference evidence

All tests are calculated before this gate. Main networks and selected-link forest
plots include only associations passing the configured statistical rule AND at
least one qualifying gene candidate on a mapped human-gut reference representative.
Only representatives with such a candidate are drawn. All other associations,
reference mappings and candidate checks are still exported; omitted means not
shown in this focused display, not an invalid association or a gene-absence claim.

`FOLLOWUP_RULE <- "nominal"` retains exploratory p < 0.05 links and shows their
unaltered q values. `"FDR"` requires q(all milk) < 0.05; no rule is relaxed if zero
links pass. The external-reference restriction NEVER changes the FDR denominator.

```{r display-evidence-gate}
display_selection <- reference_plot_selection(primary,associations,mapping,candidates,
  REF_GENOMES,MARKERS,rule=FOLLOWUP_RULE)
plot_associations <- display_selection$associations
plot_candidates <- display_selection$candidates
plot_mapping <- display_selection$mapping
write_csv(display_selection$audit,"18_plot_selection_audit_all_tests")
write_csv(display_selection$counts,"19_plot_selection_counts")
write_csv(plot_associations,"20_plotted_associations")
write_csv(plot_candidates,"21_plotted_reference_candidates")
write_csv(plot_mapping,"22_plotted_reference_mapping")
write_csv(display_selection$strict_FDR,"23_milk_wide_FDR_and_reference_links")
write_csv(display_selection$candidate_checks,"24_candidate_display_evidence_checks")
plot_paths <- merge(plot_associations,plot_candidates,by="feature",all=FALSE,sort=FALSE)
write_csv(plot_paths,"25_plotted_association_gene_paths")
knitr::kable(display_selection$counts,
  caption="Display selection only: complete statistical families and FDR remain unchanged")
```

# Networks: study associations and external evidence are different edge types

Figures below are separate for maternal and infant faecal microbiota. Gene names
belong to external reference proteins, not to measured participant genomes.
Where no link passes both gates, the audit reports zero and no empty main figure
is exported. Derived arsenic sums are not independent replications.

```{r figures, include=FALSE}

plot_catalogue_coverage <- function() {
  d <- coverage_summary
  s <- scene_new(960,190+36*nrow(d),"UHGG search coverage and unresolved evidence")
  sc_text(s,24,30,"Reference search coverage: attempted is not completed",18,face="bold")
  sc_text(s,24,57,paste("Annotations:",ANNOTATION_SCOPE,"| BLAST:",if(RUN_BLAST)BLAST_SCOPE else "not requested"),10)
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(d))) {
    y <- 90+i*36
    sc_line(s,24,y+17,936,y+17,COL$faint,.6)
    sc_text(s,30,y,d$metric[i],11)
    sc_text(s,900,y,format(d$value[i],big.mark=","),12,face="bold",anchor="end")
  }
  sc_text(s,24,s$height-30,"Species representatives only; not all strains. Unresolved taxonomy and download failures are not gene absence.",9,colour=COL$muted)
  save_scene(s,"C_catalogue_coverage")
}
plot_catalogue_coverage()
plot_network("Maternal")
plot_forest("Maternal")
plot_network("Infant")
plot_forest("Infant")
if(EXPORT_ALL_TEST_FORESTS) {
  plot_forest("Maternal",all_tests=TRUE)
  plot_forest("Infant",all_tests=TRUE)
}
write_html_gallery()
```

All figures below are existing vector files, inserted as HTML. Knitting does not
open a PNG device to display them. Full-resolution exports are in `figures/`.

```{r gallery, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
registry <- bind_rows_safe(FIGURE_REGISTRY)
cat('<div class="mami-network-gallery">\n')
for(i in seq_len(nrow(registry))) {
  svg <- readLines(registry$svg[i],warn=FALSE,encoding="UTF-8")
  svg <- svg[!grepl("^<\\?xml",svg)]
  svg <- sub('<svg ', '<svg style="max-width:100%;height:auto" ',svg,fixed=TRUE)
  cat('<h3>',xml_escape(registry$title[i]),'</h3>\n',sep="")
  cat(paste(svg,collapse="\n"),'\n')
  cat('<p>Export status: ',xml_escape(registry$status[i]),'</p>\n',sep="")
}
cat('</div>\n')
```

# Reference provenance

Full UHGG v2.0.2 species-representative metadata, GTDB taxonomy and eggNOG annotations:
<https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/metagenomics/mgnify_genomes/human-gut/v2.0.2/README_v2.0.2.txt>.
The exact source URLs and annotation-file MD5 checksums are exported.
BLAST queries are the source-provenanced reviewed bacterial UniProt snapshot; query-specific URLs and original file checksums are
exported without making a live request. No participant identifiers or data are
sent to those services. The workbook itself is never modified.

This module expands the reference catalogue while retaining a transparent
association-to-reference follow-up. A narrower FDR family is not independent
replication, and the analysis should be described as exploratory. The complete
network tables are suitable for further styling in Cytoscape; retain the evidence
and statistics columns when changing the layout.

# Figure-selection statement for the manuscript

> Networks and accompanying selected-link forest plots were restricted to milk
> arsenic–genus associations meeting the stated statistical follow-up threshold
> and having at least one mapped UHGG human-gut representative with an
> arsenic-related candidate protein. The statistical threshold and candidate
> evidence tier are explicitly labelled. All associations, unsupported mappings,
> selection exclusions, effect sizes and original multiple-testing-adjusted values
> are supplied in the complete tables. This post-analysis display restriction did
> not redefine the FDR family. Reference-species and gene evidence does not
> establish species or gene presence, expression or arsenic transformation in
> the study participants.
